correctness.rationale: Expose first t endpoints as distinct openers under T>t, with survival product p_n,t = product_{s=2}^t 2(n-s+1)/(2n-s+1), zero at n+1. The crossing pair categories opener-opener, opener-tail, tail-tail have conditional probabilities 1/2, 1/3, 1/3, giving e_n,t=n(n-1)/6+t(t-1)/12. Subtract weighted survival means for adjacent t to derive quadratic conditional regression, including final possible t=n+1. Monotone regression proves covariance positivity; Rayleigh limit T/sqrt(n) with survival exp(-x^2/4), uniform tail bound and moment convergence yield sqrt(pi)/6; classical Var(X)=n(n-1)(n+3)/45 yields stated correlation. Independent full exact enumeration matchings n2..6 (3+15+105+945+10395) matches every 20 conditional regression values and survival tests.
